Package tictactoe.server

Class ServerHandler

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Thread
tictactoe.server.ServerHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class ServerHandler extends Thread
A class that helps SocketServer handle individual client communication. Each instance of this class manages the I/O for a single client connection and runs in a separate thread.
